RQ1.criterion: zero within-pair full output differences on byte-identical views, under CRN

RQ2.circularity: RQ2 and RQ5 are consistency checks of the generator, enumeration and reference ladder. CCC-L v0 and its DEV-informed v1 extension were written knowing the separating evidence; passing is expected by design and is not a performance claim. RQ5 remains exploratory-method, including under eps=0.1.

RQ3.compatibility_fields: top-level k/n/rate/cp95 are eps=0 only; strata never pooled

RQ5.circularity: RQ2 and RQ5 are consistency checks of the generator, enumeration and reference ladder. CCC-L v0 and its DEV-informed v1 extension were written knowing the separating evidence; passing is expected by design and is not a performance claim. RQ5 remains exploratory-method, including under eps=0.1.
RQ5.undefined_denominators: criterion not established; retained as fail, no favourable imputation

frozen_criteria.RQ1: zero symmetry violations per eligible pair/method/set/epsilon cell
frozen_criteria.RQ2: Bayes-given-S pair accuracy reaches 1 on all units at the enumerated set; no method correct on both members below it beyond Bayes
frozen_criteria.RQ3: point estimate <0.25; margin iff CP95 upper <0.25
frozen_criteria.RQ4: all four class rates >0.5 in each stratum; margin iff CP95 lower >0.5
frozen_criteria.RQ4b: DEV-informed: B2+ under I1, each stratum separately: P2/P3 >0.5 AND P6/benign cooperation <=0.05
frozen_criteria.RQ5: CCC-L v1 primary, v0 beside it; every class/set/stratum: absolute selective accuracy gap <=0.02 at both costs; zero overclaims; abstention precision and recall >=0.9; P2/I4 and P3/I5 pair correctness >=0.95
frozen_criteria.RQ6: descriptive status distributions and legitimate-member support CP95
